about.intro: Khitma.net is an app that began in the precincts of the blessed Al-Aqsa Mosque. It lets people read and complete the Quran together: create a group to complete the Quran, share out its juz among the members with ease, and follow the khitma’s progress in a way that is convenient and open to everyone in your group.
about.title: How to use
about.video: The following video (in Arabic) explains in detail how to use Khitma.net.
about.bless: May Allah accept your worship, and may He keep you in His care and protection.

aqsa.description: Khitma.net began at the blessed Al-Aqsa Mosque, where its first lines of code were written, and today it is still developed from the surroundings of Jerusalem. Here we offer you a worldwide group khitma for the blessed Al-Aqsa Mosque, praying to Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, to lift the injustice from it and from all the lands of the Muslims.

gCreate.sameDesc: Everyone reads the same task in the same period, like one juz a day, or five pages a day for children. The group admin sets the task and its due date.
gCreate.notSameDesc: Each member reads a different juz, so together the group completes the whole Quran. In the next khitma, each member can get their next juz automatically.

gCreate.name: Your name (group admin)
gCreate.recurringYesDesc: For groups that complete the Quran together again and again, like a family or friends’ WhatsApp group.
gCreate.distr: Members join first, then you start the khitma and the pages of the mushaf are shared out equally among them. Best for large groups: with 60 people, each reads about ten pages.
gCreate.distrNo: Each member reads a different juz, so together the group completes the whole Quran.
gCreate.recurringNoDesc: For family khitmas for loved ones who have passed away (may Allah have mercy on them), in houses of condolence, and on special occasions.

home.intro: Start a group khitma for free and share its link with family and friends on WhatsApp: each person picks one of the 30 juz to read, and you follow the khitma together until it is complete, in sha Allah.
home.ayat: verses recited by members of Khitma.net groups
home.duaa: Be part of the great reward, in sha Allah — create your group now, and please remember us in your prayers.
home.maybe: And who knows, perhaps together we share in
home.more: good deeds or more. For “whoever reads a letter of the Book of Allah has a good deed for it, and a good deed is multiplied tenfold”, and Allah multiplies for whom He wills.
home.daymaDesc: An app that helps you keep up good deeds, for “the most beloved deed to Allah is the most regular and constant even if it were little” (Sahih al-Bukhari). Start with a small step, like one page of Quran a day.
